name: Top bar
help: For more information about this component and how it works, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#top-bar).

autoplay.name: Autoplay
autoplay.help: If enabled, slides will change automatically.

autoplay_speed.name: Autoplay speed
autoplay_speed.help: Allows to define the time interval at which slides change.

autoplay_continuous.name: Continuous autoplay
autoplay_continuous.help: If enabled, the autoplay transition will work with a continuous loop without stopping. Also, the carousel navigation elements will be hidden.

bundle_color.name: Content colors
bundle_color.help: Choose one of your Palettes shared between your chosen components or create an independent new one.
